facts.text: Audrey's dogs enjoy wearing party hats and associate them with fun and treats.

evidence.quote: They absolutely adore it! They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates. Plus, they always get excited when I bring those out.
The hats don't bother them, they just put them on for fun and treats.

facts.text: Audrey's dogs have playdates at a dog park where they can run and mingle with other dogs.

evidence.quote: They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates.
The dog park is great place to start! They can run and mingle with other pooches. It's such a fun spot for playdates!

facts.text: Audrey's dogs play fetch with a ball or frisbee during their outings.

evidence.quote: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it!

facts.text: Audrey's playdates are located near the park where they usually walk.

evidence.quote: It's right by the park we usually walk. It's a great spot with lots of trees and benches for us to watch the dogs play.
